paper.abstract_en: We show how the gravitational dynamics, phase space and Noether charges of the BMS group at future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$ can be derived as limits of their analogues on null hypersurfaces at finite distance. The Bondi mass-loss and angular-momentum evolution equations arise as limits of the Raychaudhuri and Damour constraints. The Ashtekar--Streubel (aka Wald--Zoupas) symplectic potential arises as a specific member of a two-parameter family of null-boundary symplectic potentials, corresponding to the Dirichlet (aka canonical) polarization, while the other members differ by field-space exact terms, leading to the same radiative pre-symplectic structure but potentially different BMS fluxes. Deriving the BMS charges requires additional care, since BMS generators extended into the bulk are generally not tangent to the null hypersurfaces. After accounting for this and the associated anomalies, the renormalized canonical charges still contain an additional soft contribution. The prescription of a covariant boundary Lagrangian determines a corner improvement that removes this term and recovers the standard BMS charges.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文系统研究BMS群在有限距离零超曲面上的引力动力学、相空间与Noether荷，并讨论其到未来零无穷的极限，涉及Bondi质量损失、角动量演化、零边界辛势族与边界拉格朗日量的角点改进，属于广义相对论基础中BMS荷与渐近结构方向的深入理论工作，值得点击阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们展示未来零无穷 $\mathscr{I}^+$ 处BMS群的引力动力学、相空间与Noether荷如何能作为有限距离零超曲面上对应量的极限而导出。Bondi质量损失与角动量演化方程作为Raychaudhuri约束与Damour约束的极限出现。Ashtekar--Streubel（亦称Wald--Zoupas）辛势作为一族双参数零边界辛势中的特定成员出现，对应于Dirichlet（亦称正则）极化，而其他成员相差场空间恰当项，导致相同的辐射前辛结构但可能不同的BMS通量。导出BMS荷需要额外小心，因为延伸入体内的BMS生成元一般不与零超曲面相切。在计入这一点及相关反常之后，重整化正则荷仍包含一个额外的软贡献。协变边界拉格朗日量的指定确定了一个角点改进，该改进去除这一项并恢复标准的BMS荷。
